case clip-point-raster
glctx 32 choose 0x38 0 32 0 0 32 8
gl glMatrixMode 0x1701
gl glOrtho 0 16 0 16 -1 1
gl glMatrixMode 0x1700
glp glClipPlane i 0x3004 d 1 0 0 -3.5
gl glEnable 0x3004
gl glRasterPos2f 2.5 0.5
glget i 0xb08 1
gl glRasterPos2f 3.5 0.5
glget i 0xb08 1
gl glRasterPos2f 4.5 0.5
glget i 0xb08 1
gl glClear 0x4000
gl glBegin 0
gl glVertex2f 2.5 0.5
gl glVertex2f 3.5 0.5
gl glVertex2f 4.5 0.5
gl glEnd
glread 2 0 3 1 0x1908 0x1401 12
glerr
end
